question: The head office of the Asian Development Bank is located in- (RPF Constable 2018 (12/02/2019) Shift 2)
options: Manila
Beijing
New Delhi
Singapore
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Manila

Explanation:
The headquarters of the Asian Development Bank (ADB) is located in Manila, the capital of the Philippines. ADB was established in 1966 and currently has 68 member countries. Its primary goal is to promote economic development and cooperation in the Asia-Pacific region. ADB provides loans, technical assistance, and grants to developing member countries. The headquarters is situated in the city of Mandaluyong, Metro Manila. The current president of ADB is Masatsugu Asakawa.

question: Which of the following is related to Nairobi negotiations?  (RPF Constable 2018 (14/02/2019))
options: United Nations
World Trade Organization
World Economic Forum
World Bank
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is World Trade Organization

Explanation:
The Nairobi negotiations refer to the 10th Ministerial Conference of the World Trade Organization (WTO), held in Nairobi, Kenya, in December 2015. The key outcome of these negotiations was the agreement to eliminate agricultural export subsidies by developed countries, a major step under the Doha Development Agenda. The talks also aimed to expand the Information Technology Agreement and address other trade issues. Thus, the Nairobi negotiations are directly associated with the World Trade Organization, not the United Nations, World Economic Forum, or World Bank.

☛ In which year did the Nairobi negotiations take place? → 2015

question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन नैरोबी वार्ता से सम्बन्धित है? (RPF Constable 2018 (14/02/2019))

विश्व बैंक

Explanation:

question: Cantonment Act in India was passed in _____ year.  (RPF Constable 2018 (14/02/2019))
options: 1932
1924
1962
1950
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1924

Explanation:
The Cantonment Act in India was passed in the year 1924. This act deals with the administration, management, and control of military cantonments in India. It provides for local self-government in cantonments and ensures their separate administration from civilian areas. Enacted during the British period, this act was retained after independence with amendments. Currently, the Cantonment Act 2006 (Act No. 41 of 2006) is in force, which replaced the 1924 act. India has a total of 62 cantonments, which fall under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Defence.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:

☛ How many cantonments are there in India? → 62
☛ Which ministry administers cantonments? → Ministry of Defence
☛ When was the first Cantonment Act passed? → 1924
☛ Which is the largest cantonment in India? → Kanpur Cantonment
question_hi: भारत में छावनी अधिनियम _____ वर्ष में पारित किया गया था। (RPF Constable 2018 (14/02/2019))
options_hi: 1932
1924
1962
1950
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है 1924

Explanation:
भारत में छावनी अधिनियम (Cantonment Act) वर्ष 1924 में पारित किया गया था। यह अधिनियम भारत में सैन्य छावनियों के प्रशासन, प्रबंधन और नियंत्रण से संबंधित है। इसके तहत छावनियों में स्थानीय स्वशासन की व्यवस्था की गई और इन्हें नागरिक क्षेत्रों से अलग प्रशासित किया जाता है। यह अधिनियम ब्रिटिश काल में लागू हुआ था और स्वतंत्रता के बाद भी इसे संशोधित करके बरकरार रखा गया। वर्तमान में छावनी अधिनियम 2006 (2006 का अधिनियम संख्या 41) लागू है, जिसने 1924 के अधिनियम को प्रतिस्थापित किया। भारत में कुल 62 छावनियां हैं, जो रक्षा मंत्रालय के अधीन आती हैं।

question: Which of the following is a hot air? (RPF Constable 2018 (14/02/2019) Shift 2)
options: Harmaton
Mistral
Santa Carna
Blizzard

Explanation:

question: What is that simple tool that is used to remove weeds and loosen the soil? (RPF Constable 2018 (16/02/2019))
options: Cultivator
Planters
Hoe (Khuppa)
The sickle
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Hoe (Khuppa)

Explanation:
The hoe is a simple agricultural tool used to remove weeds and loosen the soil. It is also known as a khuppa or khurpi. It consists of a long wooden handle with a metal blade attached at a right angle. Hoes are primarily used in small farms and gardening. They help in weed control and soil aeration by cutting weeds and stirring the soil. Farmers use hoes to remove grass between crops and make the soil friable. Other options: Cultivator (a farm implement for tilling), Planters (used for planting seeds), and Sickle (used for harvesting crops) are incorrect.

question: When was the name of Madras state changed to Tamil Nadu? (RPF Constable 2018 (16/02/2019) Shift 2)
options: 1966
1964
1962
1969
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1969

Explanation:
The name of Madras state was changed to Tamil Nadu on 14 January 1969. This change was made to reflect the cultural and linguistic identity of the Tamil-speaking region. Tamil Nadu means 'land of the Tamils'. Madras Presidency was renamed Madras state in 1956 under the States Reorganisation Act. After the 1967 assembly elections, the DMK party came to power and C. N. Annadurai became Chief Minister. He introduced a resolution to rename the state, which was approved by the central government. Thus, Madras state was officially declared Tamil Nadu.
